raw_segments.text: Yes, am I worth it, flashed through my mind.
After all, what am I worth that another man, a fellow creature, made in the likeness and
image of God, should serve me?
For the first time in my life this question forced itself upon me.
He had said, Mother, my little heart, in truth we are each responsible to all for all.
It's only that men don't know this.
If they knew it, the world would be a paradise at once.
